description: Generate the Express (TypeScript) OAuth 2 authorization code flow of a Tiendanube / Nuvemshop app: install redirect with state, callback that exchanges the code with a JSON body and stores the token per app and store. Returns the files for the caller to write. For a full app, it points to the official templates.

appId.description: App ID (client_id) from the Partners Portal

brand.description: Which domain the merchant sees (default tiendanube); the two token URLs are equivalent

dir.description: Folder for the generated files, relative to the project root (default "src")

name: scaffold-oauth-callback

files.description: Files to write. The server never writes to disk.

path.description: Path relative to the project root

title: Scaffold the OAuth install flow
